nodes.description: Privileged owner address; assigned from msg.sender in the constructor and compared in the onlyOwner modifier.
Pending owner in two-step handover; written by transferOwnership and checked against msg.sender in acceptOwnership.
Public token symbol string, set once in the constructor.
Public token name string, set once in the constructor.
Public decimals value (18) set once in the constructor.
Immutable token supply constant; read (and effectively never written) after construction.
mapping(address=>uint) of token balances; mutated by transfer/transferFrom and read by balanceOf/totalSupply.
Nested mapping(address=>mapping(address=>uint)) of ERC20 allowances; written by approve/approveAndCall and spent by transferFrom.
Addition with post-condition require(c >= a); pure helper used for crediting balances.
Subtraction with precondition require(b <= a); pure helper used for debiting balances and allowances.
Multiplication with overflow check require(a == 0 || c / a == b).
Division with require(b > 0) guard.
Sets owner = msg.sender at deployment, granting full privileges to the deployer.
onlyOwner function that stages a new owner in newOwner (privileged state change gated on msg.sender).
Permissionless accept step; requires msg.sender == newOwner, then promotes newOwner to owner and zeroes newOwner.
Initialises symbol/name/decimals, mints the fixed supply to a hardcoded address and emits Transfer.
Constant function returning _totalSupply - balances[address(0)] with unchecked subtraction.
Constant view returning balances[tokenOwner].
Moves tokens from balances[msg.sender] to recipient using safeSub/safeAdd; caller identity drives authorisation.
Sets allowed[msg.sender][spender] = tokens without any zeroing precondition; emits Approval.
Debits balances[from], consumes allowed[from][msg.sender] and credits recipient; allowance consumption is the only caller check.
Constant view returning allowed[tokenOwner][spender].
Writes allowance for msg.sender then performs an external callback into the caller-supplied spender contract.
Payable fallback that unconditionally reverts, refusing plain ETH transfers.
onlyOwner sweep that performs an external call into an arbitrary caller-supplied token contract.
Attacker-controlled caller identity used for ownership, balance ownership and allowance ownership.
Unchecked subtraction _totalSupply - balances[address(0)] in totalSupply() (Solidity 0.4.24 has no underflow protection).
External call ERC20Interface(tokenAddress).transfer(owner, tokens) to an arbitrary, unvalidated contract address.
External callback ApproveAndCallFallBack(spender).receiveApproval(msg.sender, tokens, this, data) into an untrusted contract with attacker-supplied calldata.
First operand of safeAdd.
Second operand of safeAdd.
Minuend operand of safeSub.
Subtrahend operand of safeSub.
First factor of safeMul.
Second factor of safeMul.
Dividend of safeDiv.
Divisor of safeDiv.
Address staged as the next owner by transferOwnership.
Recipient address of transfer; used to index the balances mapping.
Amount of tokens moved by transfer.
Spender address granted an allowance by approve.
Allowance amount written by approve.
Account debited by transferFrom.
Recipient credited by transferFrom.
Amount moved by transferFrom.
Owner queried by allowance().
Spender queried by allowance().
Caller-supplied contract address receiving the receiveApproval callback.
Allowance amount set and forwarded to the callback.
Arbitrary calldata forwarded to the untrusted receiveApproval callback.
Unvalidated external token contract address invoked by the owner sweep.
Amount forwarded to the external token contract call.
Account whose balance is returned by balanceOf.
Return value a + b checked against overflow in safeAdd.
Return value a - b produced by safeSub.
Return value a * b checked against overflow in safeMul.
Return value a / b produced by safeDiv.

edges.reason: Owned constructor assigns owner = msg.sender, deriving privileged authority directly from the caller identity.
transferOwnership is gated by the onlyOwner modifier comparing msg.sender to owner.
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender == newOwner before promoting the pending owner.
transfer debits balances[msg.sender], so authorisation is purely caller-identity based.
approve writes allowed[msg.sender][spender], binding the allowance to the caller.
transferFrom spends allowed[from][msg.sender], making the caller the allowance spender.
approveAndCall records allowance for msg.sender and forwards msg.sender into the untrusted callback.
transferAnyERC20Token is protected by onlyOwner which compares msg.sender to owner.
Recipient address of transfer indexes the balances mapping being written.
transfer amount is passed to safeSub when debiting the sender balance.
transfer amount is passed to safeAdd when crediting the recipient balance.
'from' account of transferFrom is debited through safeSub.
transferFrom amount is passed to safeSub for both balance and allowance deduction.
transferFrom amount is passed to safeAdd for the recipient credit.
Recipient address of transferFrom indexes the balances mapping write.
spender parameter becomes the second-level key of the allowed allowance mapping.
approved token amount is stored in the allowed allowance mapping.
Caller-supplied spender address becomes the callee of the untrusted receiveApproval callback.
Token amount is forwarded as an argument into the untrusted callback.
Arbitrary bytes calldata is forwarded verbatim to the untrusted callback.
Unvalidated tokenAddress parameter is used as the target of the external ERC20 call.
Tokens parameter is forwarded as the amount argument of the external contract call.
owner state variable is read as the destination address of the external sweep call.
_totalSupply is read as the minuend of an unchecked subtraction.
balances[address(0)] is subtracted without an underflow guard in totalSupply().
Execution of totalSupply() reaches the unchecked subtraction expression.
approveAndCall invokes receiveApproval on a caller-supplied contract, handing control to untrusted code.
transferAnyERC20Token performs an external call into an arbitrary contract supplied by the owner.
Privileged transferOwnership writes the staged owner into newOwner.
acceptOwnership reads newOwner to validate msg.sender before promotion.
acceptOwnership promotes newOwner into the owner state variable.
acceptOwnership resets newOwner to address(0) at the end of the handover.
transfer writes updated sender and recipient entries in the balances mapping.
transferFrom decreases the spender entry in the allowed allowance mapping.
balanceOf returns the balances mapping entry for tokenOwner.
totalSupply returns _totalSupply adjusted by the zero-address balance.
Constructor writes the token symbol.
Constructor writes the token name.
Constructor writes the decimals value.
Constructor sets the fixed total supply.
Constructor credits the entire supply to a hardcoded address in the balances mapping.
onlyOwner modifier compares msg.sender with owner before transferOwnership executes.
onlyOwner modifier compares msg.sender with owner before the privileged sweep executes.
